results.title: People Drive From All Over Indiana For The Outrageously Delicious Southern Food At This Unassuming Restaurant
results.author: Author  Madison White
results.text:
Skip to Content

In a world of flashy food trends and Instagram-worthy plating, there exists a culinary sanctuary where substance triumphantly outshines style.

Simply Southern Soul Food in Indianapolis is the kind of place that makes you wonder if your GPS has malfunctioned when you first pull up.

The bold red “SIMPLY SOUTHERN” sign beckons like a lighthouse for hungry souls wandering the Indianapolis suburbs. Southern comfort awaits inside this unassuming strip mall treasure. Photo credit: Local Investor

But trust me – you’re exactly where you need to be.

The first thing that hits you when you walk through the door isn’t an elaborate décor scheme or carefully curated playlist – it’s the aroma.

That intoxicating blend of fried chicken, slow-cooked greens, and baking cornbread creates an olfactory experience so powerful it should come with a warning label.

This unassuming strip mall restaurant has become a pilgrimage site for Hoosiers willing to drive hours for a taste of authentic Southern cooking that’s as honest as it is delicious.

The space itself speaks to a refreshing priority system – why spend money on fancy light fixtures when you could invest in better ingredients?

Minimalist dining with maximum flavor potential. The simple interior lets you focus on what matters—the impending food coma you’ll happily embrace after your meal. Photo credit: josiah freeman

The simple tables and chairs, basic lighting, and minimalist wall décor all send a clear message: we’re not here to dazzle you with ambiance; we’re here to knock your socks off with flavor.

Their logo on the wall – featuring a chef’s hat and steam rising from a covered dish – is perhaps the only adornment needed, a simple promise of what’s to come.

You’ll notice the dining room has a straightforward, no-nonsense approach with polished concrete floors and wooden tables that could be at home in any decade from the 1950s to today.

It’s an environment that puts zero obstacles between you and a transformative food experience.

In the world of soul food, authenticity isn’t just a buzzword – it’s the entire foundation.

This menu isn’t just a list—it’s a roadmap to happiness. From oxtails to fried chicken, your toughest decision today will be choosing just one entrée. Photo credit: Local Investor

What Simply Southern has accomplished is nothing short of miraculous: they’ve managed to transport genuine Deep South cooking traditions to Indiana without losing a speck of their soul in transit.

This isn’t “inspired by” or “our take on” Southern cuisine – this is the real deal, the kind of cooking that makes actual Southerners nod with approval and reach for another piece of cornbread.

Let’s talk about that menu, which reads like a greatest hits compilation of Southern classics executed with remarkable precision.

Their fried chicken deserves poetry written about it – the skin shatters with a satisfying crunch, revealing meat so juicy it borders on indecent.

The seasoning strikes that
